Done. Have Carlos send the intro and I'll get on their calendar for Thursday. One other thing — I want to talk about the Omega expansion opportunity in the board meeting. $180K net-new on top of a renewal is a strong land-and-expand story. Make sure that's in the deck.

:rotating_light: *CRITICAL INCIDENT — P0 | Authentication Service Degradation*

*Status:* Active — elevated error rates on SSO login across enterprise tier
*Impacted:* ~30% of enterprise users unable to authenticate via SSO

*Root Cause Analysis:*
A certificate rotation pushed in last night's deployment (v4.12.1) introduced a mismatch between the identity provider metadata and our internal token validation service. The cert rotation completed successfully in staging but the production identity provider cache was not flushed, causing token verification to fail for a subset of enterprise SSO configurations.

*Actions Taken:*
• Deployment v4.12.1 rolled back to v4.11.9 at 08:42 UTC
• IDP cache flush initiated across all production nodes
• Engineering war room active — @channel looped in
• Customer comms sent to all affected enterprise accounts

*Expected Resolution:* Cache propagation completing now. Full service restoration expected by *10:30 UTC* (~45 min). We will post an all-clear here once confirmed.

Updates every 15 min until resolved.
